final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is substantively useful: it concedes the packet does not establish clean compliance and limits the support to a caveated operational-readiness defense. But that narrower position is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here, because the caveat is not merely a disclosure note or residual-risk qualifier; it is an unresolved compliance predicate under the stated policy. The available policy text says a weakness is material if it affects a named launch use case, and the record still indicates the shelter segment misses target, is tied to named commitments, and remains under open legal review. Without evidence of required disclosure or approved risk acceptance, the certification-as-compliant claim remains inadequately supported on admissible evidence.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the shelter-segment limitation was disclosed before launch.
No admissible evidence shows an approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering the shelter-segment gap.
The affected segment is still described as a named launch use case tied to nonprofit commitments, which keeps the policy materiality trigger live.
Legal review remains open on disclosure, so the policy predicate is unresolved on the present record.
Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public governance guidance support operational readiness arguments but do not satisfy the internal disclosure/risk-acceptance condition.
